name: iotedu
description: Local desktop hub for managing ESP32-H2 Matter-over-Thread nodes.

scripts.dev: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/dev-runtime.mjs concurrently -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @iotedu/local-api" "npm run dev -w @iotedu/desktop-ui"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @iotedu/contracts && npm run test -w @iotedu/catalog && npm run test -w @iotedu/firmware-builder && npm run test -w @iotedu/matter-controller && npm run test -w @iotedu/local-api && npm run test -w @iotedu/desktop-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @iotedu/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @iotedu/catalog && npm run typecheck -w @iotedu/firmware-builder && npm run typecheck -w @iotedu/matter-controller && npm run typecheck -w @iotedu/local-api && npm run typecheck -w @iotedu/desktop-ui
